ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring platform that tracks industrial land compliance and deforestation changes in real time.
ideas.title: EcoWatch Satellite Monitoring
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by combining geospatial imaging data with automated compliance checks, appealing strongly to judges looking for scalable environmental impact under the Innovate Without Borders theme.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine specifically built for specialized medical clinics operating across international borders.
ideas.title: GlobalSmile Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the global, borderless scope of the hackathon using proven architectures from the Global-Smile prize winner that streamline patient trust and onboarding.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support platform that assists international learners by combining LangGraph, RAG, and personalized AI agents.
ideas.title: GreenNovation Multi-Agent Student Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning architecture of the greennovation-ai-platform to deliver localized, reliable mentorship across educational institutions worldwide.

ideas.pitch: An AML risk detection and investigation platform that combines graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models for cross-border financial transactions.
ideas.title: Bito AML Risk Detective
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the technical depth and compliance-focus of Bito, addressing the heavy due-diligence priorities of enterprise-minded hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace facilitating instant services with USDC escrow payments settled on low-cost layer-2 chains.
ideas.title: Dispatch Cross-Border USDC Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the proven Dispatch architecture to demonstrate real-world financial utility for freelancers and remote workers across multiple borders.
